description: My name is Fawad. I love exploring space, learning about planets, and creating robots. I am especially interested in Mars and how robots can help astronauts explore the planet. I enjoy being creative, learning new things, and exploring new ideas. I am looking for teammates who are interested in space, robotics, coding, and creative thinking. Together, we can create something amazing!
summary:
Project Title: Build a Junior Astronaut Mission

I developed an exciting Mars adventure game called Junior Astronaut Mission using PictoBlox. In this game, a young astronaut must complete five missions to survive on Mars and save the Mars base.

The five missions are:

1. Save Oxygen – Collect oxygen to breathe.
2. Power Emergency – Collect batteries for energy.
3. Food Survival – Collect food to survive.
4. Safety Mission – Collect safety shields for protection.
5. Rescue Mission – Collect tools to save the Mars base.

They must avoid dangerous meteors and dust storms. If they hit an obstacle, the game ends. Completing all five missions wins the game!

How does it address the challenge?

This project introduces young children to space exploration through fun, interactive learning. It helps them understand the basic needs of astronauts on Mars.

Why is it important?

My game develops problem-solving, quick thinking, creativity and basic coding skills. It encourages children to explore science, technology and space through play.
details: Our project, Build a Junior Astronaut Mission, is a fun and interactive Mars adventure game developed using PictoBlox. In this game, children become junior astronauts and complete five exciting missions to survive on Mars. The missions include collecting oxygen, batteries, food, safety shields and tools to save the Mars base. Players use the left and right arrow keys to move and the up arrow key to jump while avoiding dangerous meteors and dust storms. If the astronaut touches an obstacle, the game ends, but completing all five missions makes the player a winner! We developed this game using Scratch-based block coding in PictoBlox, with colourful sprites, Mars backgrounds, animations and sound effects. Our project is creative because it combines space exploration, storytelling and coding with fun challenges. We designed the game with simple controls so that even KG2 children can play easily. The main aim of our project is to help young learners understand the basic needs of astronauts, develop problem-solving and logical thinking skills, improve hand-eye coordination and inspire an interest in science, technology, coding and space exploration through enjoyable learning.
